risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Polymers constitute a major component of the company's cost structure; volatility in crude oil and polymer prices may impact raw material procurement costs and operating margins.
- Regulatory changes relating to plastics usage, environmental compliance and waste management norms may increase compliance requirements and operational costs.
- Economic slowdowns, inflationary pressures, or moderation in consumer spending may impact demand for discretionary lifestyle and furniture products, which are the company's core offering.
- The company flags a rising number of players contending for market prominence, amplifying pressure to innovate and differentiate.
- The company sells a significant share of products through the Amazon Fulfilled and Flipkart Assured programmes and other e-commerce portals, exposing it to platform policy and ratings/review dynamics set by third parties.
- The company's operations are classified as a single or main business segment (plastic furniture manufacturing, with a nascent recycling subsidiary), so results are concentrated in this one activity rather than diversified across segments.
